article.title: Rehearsal for an Afternoon in the Future: Augusto Boal in a Caracas Commune
article.author: Cira Pascual Marquina
article.content: Rehearsal never really stops: people plan, argue, and intervene in their own reality all the time, so the distance between stage and audience was minimal from the start.
